selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What two things must happen for the ruler’s goals for the palace to be reached?
questions.answer: The teacher must be there, and the people must listen to him and follow his words.

questions.question: Why is the teacher so important in the palace story?
questions.answer: He explains the meaning and purpose of the palace.

questions.question: What picture is used to show why a teacher is needed?
questions.answer: A hard-to-understand book without a teacher is like paper with no real meaning.

questions.question: What does the passage say the teacher’s being there causes?
questions.answer: It is the reason the palace was built.

questions.question: What does the people’s listening to the teacher cause?
questions.answer: It helps the palace stay as it is and continue.

questions.question: What might the ruler have done if there were no teacher at all?
questions.answer: He would not have built the palace.

questions.question: What happens if people do not pay attention to the teacher’s directions?
questions.answer: The palace will surely be changed into something else.

questions.question: Is the passage teaching that hearing the teacher is enough, or that people should also follow him?
questions.answer: They should also follow him.

questions.question: What is the main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The teacher and the people’s obedience are both necessary for the palace’s purpose.

questions.question: Who is speaking to the listener in this passage?
questions.answer: A friend is speaking to another friend.

questions.question: What does the speaker say the listener has already understood?
questions.answer: That the great ruler built the palace for the goals told earlier.

questions.question: How many main things does the passage say those goals depend on?
questions.answer: Two.

questions.question: What is the first of those two things?
questions.answer: The teacher must exist.

questions.question: What is the second of those two things?
questions.answer: The people must accept what the teacher says and act on it.

questions.question: How does the example of the difficult book help us understand the palace?
questions.answer: It shows that without someone to explain, people cannot understand what they are looking at.

questions.question: What does the passage connect to the start of the palace?
questions.answer: The presence of the teacher.

questions.question: What does the passage connect to the palace continuing on?
questions.answer: The people listening to the teacher.

questions.question: What warning is given at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: If people ignore the teacher, the palace will definitely be changed.

questions.question: What is one needed means named first in the passage?
questions.answer: The teacher.

questions.question: What work does the teacher do for the palace?
questions.answer: He helps people understand it.

questions.question: What would an unclear book be like if no one taught it?
questions.answer: It would seem empty of meaning.

questions.question: What must the people do after hearing the teacher?
questions.answer: They must accept his words and pay attention to them.

questions.question: Which is linked to the palace being made: the people’s listening or the teacher’s existence?
questions.answer: The teacher’s existence.

questions.question: Which is linked to the palace remaining as it should: the teacher’s existence or the people’s listening?
questions.answer: The people’s listening.

title: Secret of the Parable Presence of the Master and Acceptance of His Word
